title: Ecology federal permits record: Jensen's Shipyard Cove Facility Haul Out Pier Replacement (Aquatics 145947)

rows.label: Project
rows.value: Jensen's Shipyard Cove Facility Haul Out Pier Replacement

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: The project proposes to decommission and remove the existing Jensen’s Shipyard Cove Facility (Facility) haul out pier (HOP) and to install a replacement structure in a more suitable location within the Facility that provides direct access to deeper subtidal water and minimizes potential disturbances to intertidal and shallow subtidal habitat. The Port would also replace an existing float with a new grated float immediately adjacent to the new HOP to support HOP operations. The Port would also remove the following existing structures: 109 creosote-treated piles and pile stubs; 95 linear feet of vertical concrete shoreline protection; a concrete slab; creosote-treated timber rails; and miscellaneous marine debris. The existing HOP and associated overwater dock footprint is approximately 1,800 square feet (sf). The existing float footprint to be removed and partially replaced in support of HOP operations is 1,184 sf.
